summary: A Facebook (Marketplace) buyer from the Miami area who arranged to pick up an item at the phone owner's downtown apartment complex on 2026-06-28. The owner fell asleep and missed the meetup after the buyer drove ~20 miles and waited an hour, then offered $50 off as an apology. The buyer returned the next morning (2026-06-29), paid $300 via Zelle, and completed the pickup. One-off transaction with no ALTR business services involved; buyer was patient and easy to deal with if a future sale comes up.
